moments.action: An invigilator in a pale blazer walks toward the dark doorway of the library exam hall; Lynn and Bank look up from their desks, then the digital clock above the door reads 8:29:58.
A candidate flips the STIC booklet open, the pages spread; Lynn starts writing on her lap-desk with Bank beside her, and the wide of the hall ends with every row already bent over the paper.
Lynn reads, her watched hand moving over the answer grid; inserts of question 17, the clock at 8:51, then bubbles filling in until the pencil reaches question 26 - she has run deep into the section.
Lynn writes head-down in the row, then the scene shifts to Bank: tight on his face as he mouths to himself, then wide at his desk where he glances off and settles back into writing.
Hands ink answers onto the STIC Section 1 sheet; Bank mouths silently and Pat, rows away, raises a hand to his face. The last shot holds on fingers laid flat across the half-filled grid.
Bank frowns over his paper and Lynn stares down at hers, both tightening; the clock above the door turns 9:09:59 and the camera whips off it into a smear of red - the time is nearly gone.
A pencil darkens bubble 52-C, the shot holds long on 51-B and 52-C, then both hands spread flat over the finished Section 1 grid - the sheet is now complete to the last row.
Lynn mouths the answers to herself; Pat shuts his eyes and repeats them back, Bank in profile beside another candidate, and the answer grid drifts out of focus as the recital takes over.
Lynn sits with her eyes closed, lips moving, while the answer sheet doubles and blurs; the clock reads 9:14:59 and she ends looking up and away past Bank, who is still hunched over his paper.
